name: Copilot Agent Environment Setup

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup-env:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version-file: 'rust-toolchain.toml'

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@v8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'
          scope: ''

      - name: Set up pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@10.13.1

      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: latest
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: cargo install cargo-binstall

      - name: Install development tools
        run: just install

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Verify tool installations
        run: |
          rustc --version
          node --version
          pnpm --version
          just --version
          cargo-binstall --version
          watchexec-cli --version
          cargo-insta --version
          typos-cli --version
          cargo-shear --version
          dprint --version

      - name: Check build environment
        run: cargo check

      - name: Completion message
        run: echo "Environment setup complete. Available commands: just ready, just fmt, just test, just lint"

name: Copilot Agent Environment Setup

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup-env:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version-file: 'rust-toolchain.toml'

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@v8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'
          scope: ''

      - name: Set up pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@10.13.1

      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: latest
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: cargo install cargo-binstall

      - name: Install development tools
        run: just install

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Verify tool installations
        run: |
          rustc --version
          node --version
          pnpm --version
          just --version
          cargo-binstall --version
          watchexec-cli --version
          cargo-insta --version
          typos-cli --version
          cargo-shear --version
          dprint --version

      - name: Check build environment
        run: cargo check
